blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — A 37-year-old farmer was arrested after he allegedly hacked his live-in partner in Sitio Cansili, Barangay Nug-as, Alcoy town, on Tuesday afternoon, September 29, 2026. The suspect was identified as alias “Bakig,” a resident of the area. Earlier, the Alcoy Municipal Police Station received a call from a concerned citizen reporting the incident.
